Answer with status, value, quotes and section.

answer.value: The card has no dedicated limitations section. It warns that an incorrect Transformers config entry caused long-context performance degradation, which also affects GGUFs generated from the pre-fix config. It also says frameworks that rely on the Transformers config will show subpar performance, especially in long-context sessions, unless they include the fix.
quotes: The Transformers config originally had an incorrect entry that caused long-context performance degradation.
GGUFs generated using the Transformers config prior to this commit are also affected.
Otherwise, you will experience subpar performance, especially in long-context sessions.
